related_questions.question: How long does the Long COVID last?

text_blocks.snippet: Long COVID, also known as Post COVID-19 condition, can last for weeks, months, or even years after the initial COVID-19 infection. It's characterized by a range of ongoing symptoms that can impact various organ systems and affect daily activities.

list.title: Duration:
list.snippet: Long COVID symptoms can start within 3 months of the initial COVID-19 illness and last for at least 2 months, according to the World Health Organization (WHO).

list.title: Variability:
list.snippet: The duration and specific symptoms can vary significantly from person to person.

list.title: Multi-organ effects:
list.snippet: Some individuals may experience multi-organ effects or autoimmune conditions lasting weeks, months, or years after COVID-19.

list.title: Impact on daily life:
list.snippet: Long COVID can affect a person's ability to work, perform household chores, and engage in other daily activities.
